pendingQuestions: PRD Q5: confirm which services VoxFlow will actually sell and deliver in December
meta.rule: expectedResult never contains numbers or guarantees; the founder states figures on the meeting, not the AI caller
meta.fittingSignals: keys must exist in config/niches/<niche>.json → signalWeights

services.name: AI voice receptionist
services.problem: Patients call and nobody picks up, especially during treatments, lunch and after hours.
services.expectedResult: Every call is answered in Urdu or English, questions are handled and appointments are booked even when staff are busy.
services.expectedResultUrdu: ہر کال کا جواب دیا جاتا ہے اور اپوائنٹمنٹ بُک ہو جاتی ہے، چاہے اسٹاف مصروف ہو

services.name: Missed-call WhatsApp reply
services.nameUrdu: مسڈ کال پر خودکار واٹس ایپ جواب
services.problem: Callers who are not answered go to another clinic.
services.expectedResult: Every missed caller gets a WhatsApp message within a minute with a booking option.
services.expectedResultUrdu: ہر مسڈ کال کرنے والے کو فوراً واٹس ایپ پر بکنگ کا آپشن مل جاتا ہے

services.name: WhatsApp booking assistant
services.problem: Booking needs a phone call during clinic hours, and patients complain about waiting to get an appointment.
services.expectedResult: Patients book, reschedule and get answers on WhatsApp at any time without staff involvement.
services.expectedResultUrdu: مریض کسی بھی وقت واٹس ایپ پر خود اپوائنٹمنٹ بُک کر لیتے ہیں

services.name: Appointment reminders and no-show reduction
services.problem: Booked patients forget and do not show up, leaving empty chair time.
services.expectedResult: Patients get automatic reminders and can confirm or reschedule in one reply.
services.expectedResultUrdu: مریضوں کو خودکار یاد دہانی ملتی ہے اور خالی اپوائنٹمنٹس کم ہوتی ہیں

services.name: Online booking page
services.problem: The website has no way to book; visitors leave without contacting the clinic.
services.expectedResult: Website visitors pick a doctor and time slot and get a confirmation automatically.
services.expectedResultUrdu: ویب سائٹ پر آنے والے خود ٹائم سلاٹ منتخب کر کے بکنگ کر لیتے ہیں

services.name: Website chat assistant
services.problem: Visitors have questions about treatments and timings and nobody answers on the website.
services.expectedResult: An assistant on the website answers common questions and turns visitors into bookings.
services.expectedResultUrdu: ویب سائٹ پر سوالات کا فوری جواب ملتا ہے اور وزیٹر بکنگ کر لیتے ہیں

services.name: Google review reply automation
services.problem: Most Google reviews have no reply, which makes the clinic look unattended to new patients.
services.expectedResult: Every review gets a polite, personal reply drafted for approval, so the profile looks active.
services.expectedResultUrdu: ہر ریویو کا مناسب جواب جاتا ہے اور گوگل پروفائل فعال نظر آتا ہے

services.name: Post-visit review requests
services.nameUrdu: وزٹ کے بعد ریویو کی درخواست
services.problem: Happy patients rarely leave reviews, while unhappy ones do.
services.expectedResult: After each visit patients get a short WhatsApp asking for a Google review.
services.expectedResultUrdu: ہر وزٹ کے بعد مطمئن مریضوں سے ریویو کی درخواست خودکار طریقے سے جاتی ہے

services.name: Patient recall campaigns
services.problem: Past patients are never reminded about check-ups, cleanings or follow-up treatment.
services.expectedResult: Past patients get timely check-up reminders and book again.
services.expectedResultUrdu: پرانے مریضوں کو چیک اپ کی یاد دہانی ملتی ہے اور وہ دوبارہ آتے ہیں

services.name: Ad and social inquiry follow-up
services.nameUrdu: اشتہارات سے آنے والی انکوائریز کا فالو اپ
services.problem: Inquiries from Facebook, Instagram and ads are answered late or not at all.
services.expectedResult: Every inquiry is answered within minutes and followed up until it books or declines.
services.expectedResultUrdu: ہر انکوائری کا چند منٹ میں جواب اور فالو اپ ہوتا ہے
